# AI Tech Lead Framework notice

This repository includes files from the AI Tech Lead Framework:
https://github.com/andreoucostas/ai-tech-lead

The framework's MIT licence governs the framework-authored portions installed under `.claude/`,
`.github/`, `LICENSES/`, `scripts/`, `specs/`, `tests/hooks/`, and `docs/`, plus the
framework-authored root files
`CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `TECH_DEBT.md`, `SECURITY_FINDINGS.md`, `LEARNINGS.md`,
`FRAMEWORK-CONTEXT.md`, and this notice. It does not govern consumer-authored content added to or
alongside those files.

The licence text is in `LICENSES/ai-tech-lead-MIT.txt`.

The installed framework version is recorded in `.claude/framework-version.json`. Deliberately do
not add a version here: that would create a second release-stamping surface and a new source of
version drift.
